feedback.title: Share Your Feedback | Saint Charbel
feedback.meta-description: Tell us what would help your prayer and your visit - suggestions, corrections, or a word of encouragement. Every message is read by a person.

feedback.header-a-our-lady-of-lebanon-at: Our Lady of Lebanon at Harissa
feedback.main-main-content-this-site-exi: This site exists for your prayer. If something helped you, something is broken, or something is missing - a guide you wished for, a correction we should make, a prayer you could not find - write it here. Every message is read by a person, and the ones that can improve the site become real tasks on our work board.
feedback.main-main-content-your-message-: Your message stays private. We may use it to improve the site, but we never publish your words or your name.
feedback.main-feedback-form-what-kind-of: What kind of feedback is this?
feedback.main-feedback-form-a-suggestion: A suggestion - something to add or change
feedback.main-feedback-form-a-question-a: A question about the faith or the site
feedback.main-feedback-form-between-10-a: Between 10 and 2,000 characters. Please do not include medical records, passwords, or other sensitive information.
feedback.main-feedback-form-a-first-name: A first name is plenty. Leave it empty to stay anonymous.
feedback.main-feedback-form-email-option: Email (optional - only if you want a reply)
feedback.main-feedback-form-used-only-to: Used only to answer you. Never shared, never added to a list.
feedback.main-feedback-form-complete-the: Complete the security check, then send your feedback.
feedback.footer-div-reader-feedback-huma: Reader feedback, human-reviewed. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
feedback.body-textarea-message-placehold: Write it simply, the way you would tell a friend.
